A Career In Beer And Beyond
Our purpose at Molson Coors Beverage Company is to brew beverages that unite people to celebrate all life’s moments. We’ve been brewing iconic brands for over 350 years and are now proud to be offering a modern portfolio that expands beyond the beer aisle.
We are Talent Brewers with our culture rooted in our core Values.
We believe in our brands and our people, and that diversity WITH inclusion is the key to a winning team culture. We want you to join our team of brand ambassadors who believe the world is full of untapped opportunities. So, if you get excited about making a real difference as part of a winning team like we do, we want to hear from you.
The Headlines
In the role of Sr. Internal Auditor, you will be working in our Milwaukee Office and part of the Global Internal Audit (GIA) function that provides independent, objective assurance and advisory services designed to add value and improve our operations. This position reports to the Manager, Internal Audit, and partners with business functions to identify areas of risk, make valuable recommendations to management, and influence positive change within the organization.
This position is responsible for executing the planning and execution of data analysis initiatives within the department by supporting the development, implementation, and sustainment of analytics within GIA. This role will harness the power of data to fundamentally change how GIA functions as an organization. You’ll work in a dynamic environment, have an opportunity to grow your passion and career within beverage industry and make a positive impact in the company.
The Responsibilities
Data Analytics
Recommend types of analytics and procedures to apply to meet set objectives.
Demonstrate ability to understand data flows and business processes.
Perform model creation, testing, execution and maintenance of database, scripting, and analytics.
Identify, acquire, consolidate, and manage data relevant to support objectives; develop repeatable analysis methods; and develop structures to maintain analytics knowledge base.
Provide data driven insights that confirms or refutes hypothesis.
Develop & sustain dashboards or decks to support objectives.
Familiar with data visualization tools, (i.e., Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
Able to apply creative and analytical mindset to assess large data set pattens, trends and anomalies.
Demonstrate ability to use available tools, (i.e., Microsoft suite, Visio, PowerPoint, etc.).
Provide preliminary to final data analysis reports, extracts, or searchable records for team, stakeholders, or management.
Other
Ability to work in a changing environment while prioritizing and managing various tasks.
Perform special projects at the request of management.
Identify cost recovery/avoidance and process control improvement opportunities.
Promote Internal Audit as a value add to the organization and deliver audit services that consistently improve the control environment and achieve operational excellence.
Set objectives, drive results, contribute as a team player, and confidently interact with a variety of stakeholders.
Possess good business acumen. Stay current with analytic techniques/technology.
The Qualifications
You have a bachelor’s degree in computer / data science, finance / economics, psychology, management information systems or related field and/or experience in data acquisition, manipulation, modeling, and analysis. SAP experience preferred.
Experience in database querying, writing/scripting (e.g., ACL, SQL, Python, R, etc.) procedures, complex joins, and indexes.
Working experience with data visualization technologies such as Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, etc.
Strong organization skills to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously.
Have a working knowledge of Sarbanes Oxley.
Ability to handle ambiguity with assigned objectives and to think creatively to deliver value add for the enterprise.
About
Work Perks that You Need to Know About:
Flexible work programs that support work life balance including a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office
We care about our People and Planet and have challenged ourselves with stretch goals around our key priorities
We care about our communities, and play our part to make a difference – from charitable donations to hitting the streets together to build parks, giving back to the community is part of our culture and who we are
Engagement with a variety of Employee Resource Groups, which can provide volunteer opportunities, leadership experience, and networking through the organization
Ability to grow and develop your career centered around our First Choice Learning opportunities
Participation in our Total Rewards program with a competitive base salary, incentive plans, parental leave, health, dental, vision, 401k option with incredible employer match, generous paid time off plans, an engaging Wellness Program, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with amazing resources
On site Pub , access to cool brand clothing and swag, top events and, of course... free beer and beverages!
Work within a fast paced and innovative company, meeting passionate colleagues and partners with diverse backgrounds and experiences
At Molson Coors we seek diversity. Differing perspectives lead to challenging the expected, which keeps new ideas bubbling up. We’re an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from candidates from all backgrounds, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic. We take pride in celebrating our unique brew.
Should you need accommodation due to disability [or any other protected status] during the recruitment process, please contact Accessibility@molsoncoors.com .

Job Overview
The Data Engineering Intern will be an integral part of the Digital Technology Services (DTS) team, focusing on building and maintaining data pipelines for our Azure-based Cloud Data Platform. The intern will work closely with associate Data Engineers to ensure data quality and secure data ingestion from various source systems.
The intern will report to the Manager of Data Engineering and collaborate with Lead Data Engineers as well as offshore implementation partners.
The working hours per week will be 20-40 hours, hours per week can be determined on candidate availability & experience level.
The internship is remote with the ability to work virtually and participate in meetings and collaborative discussions virtually.
Job Responsibilities And Essential Duties
Data Ingestion and Pipeline Building, this requires knowledge in Azure services like Synapse, ADLS, and DataBricks as well as experience with SQL and Python (or another OOP language) to develop, build, and maintain data pipelines.
Data Quality Assurance, this requires the use of data profiling tools and writing SQL queries to ensure the quality, integrity, and reliability of ingested data.
Collaborative Planning and Agile Methodology, this requires active participation in planning meetings, sprint reviews, and daily stand-ups, as well as an understanding of agile methodologies to contribute to sprint goals and tasks.
Documentation and Reporting, this requires creating clear, concise documentation for data models, data dictionaries, and also maintaining progress reports to ensure tasks are completed as per the timelines.
Minimum Requirements
Currently enrolled in a Computer Science, Data Science, or related STEM program
Familiarity with SQL and at least one Object-Oriented Programming language
Participation in extracurriculars, such as Hackathon, Coding or Math Competition, prior relevant internship experience, or demonstrated project completion
Understanding of SQL and cloud platforms (Azure preferred, GCP/AWS acceptable)
Python, C++, or other OOP language
Strong communication skills and a commitment to collaborative problem solving and teamwork
Ability to manage workload and priorities by escalating as required
